patch.diff (commit 26828cb3) inserts `attr->name = NULL;` immediately after `id->name = attr->name;` in xmlTextReaderRemoveID. Running the SAME PoC on n132/arvo:12419-vul double-frees; on n132/arvo:12419-fix it prints 'Execution successful' and exits 0. vul-crash && fix-clean confirms this missing ownership-clear is the root cause. Node is between-frames so it does not appear on the ASan stacks; verified deterministically by the patch differential rather than by a crash-stack line.
